claim_legs.durability: Prospective source pins, exact committed dependencies, first-run observations and complete recovery manifests are tracked. Saved-only audit/recovery authenticate without new fixtures or original raw-log access. The preflight verifies exact original setup and row-oracle adaptation; the book disposition names the explicit watcher.
claim_legs.falsify: Independent source-scope and healthy-prefix/remaining-owner oracles agree before and after execution. Row/domain/header controls reject lost closes, altered effects, wrong controlled setup, changed canonical image/source and a restored final reference. Recovery-copy and book-count controls reject missing or redirected evidence and outcome redistribution.
claim_legs.rederive: Committed selectors define the last-observation domain. Immutable observations preserve actual calls, close returns, EIO reports, inactive attempts and file effects. The original last-state oracle reads stored reference JSON and compares the entire canonical image subtree to its original identities and bytes. The book watcher independently recounts cases and TAP.

commit_gate: Staged doctrines and normal commit hooks must pass before commit.
limits: Primary/grouped errors, genuine omissions, final report/release applicability and native/lifetime remain separate. No prior qualifier/fixture, original main or native process is replayed. Historical startup/parent/full CI/push remain gated.
scope: Last-observation healthy control and every selected single EIO close report. Identity-checked controlled setup precedes observed release. Actual close success and native closure precede substituted EIO; final-hold effects and exact canonical-image preservation are verified separately.
